completed.definition: Evaluation requests with actual pickup and dropoff, including later fulfillment

wait_mean_s.definition: Actual boarding start minus original request time, served evaluation requests

wait_p50_s.definition: Median wait among served evaluation requests

wait_p95_s.definition: 95th percentile wait among served evaluation requests

ride_mean_s.definition: Dropoff/alighting start minus pickup/boarding start; served evaluation requests

pickup_promise_mae_s.definition: Absolute actual-minus-accepted pickup error; completed evaluation requests with promises

pickup_late_rate.definition: Actual pickup later than accepted promise; completed evaluation requests with promises

driver_offer_attempts.definition: Actual human offer attempts, whole physical run

reoffered_requests.definition: Unique requests actually offered to more than one distinct human driver; whole run

repeat_driver_offer_attempts.definition: Repeated attempts to the same request/driver pair; whole run

driver_outside_choices.definition: Driver menus selecting the outside option; whole run; unavailable when choice disabled

driver_menu_conflicts.definition: Selected driver offers lost to request conflicts; whole run; unavailable when choice disabled

driver_declines.definition: Actual declined human offer attempts, whole physical run

driver_acceptances.definition: Actual accepted human offers, whole physical run

offer_acceptance_rate.definition: Accepted human offer attempts / actual attempts; not request completion

terminal_declined_requests.definition: Unique request IDs with a terminal driver decline, whole physical run

utilization.definition: Occupied vehicle seconds / online vehicle seconds in evaluation clock

idle_share.definition: Unlogged or explicitly idle online seconds / online seconds in evaluation clock

empty_distance_km.definition: Occupancy-zero distance over whole physical run, including warm-up/tail

empty_distance_share.definition: Empty / all driven distance over the same whole physical run

av_reposition_distance_km.definition: Empty AV repositioning distance over the whole physical run

reposition_distance_km.definition: Repositioning legs over whole physical run; not all empty driving

vehicle_modeled_net_earnings_mean_cent.definition: Per-driver modeled fare minus distance/fixed/toll cost, whole run/tail; not observed wages

human_earnings_per_online_hour_mean_cent.definition: Mean human-driver modeled net / own online hours, whole run/tail

human_earnings_cv.definition: Human-driver CV of modeled per-online-hour earnings; whole run/tail

human_earnings_p10_cent.definition: Human driver p10 modeled per-online-hour earnings; whole run/tail

human_earnings_p50_cent.definition: Human driver p50 modeled per-online-hour earnings; whole run/tail

human_earnings_p90_cent.definition: Human driver p90 modeled per-online-hour earnings; whole run/tail

human_earnings_gini.definition: Human-driver modeled per-online-hour earnings Gini; unavailable with negative earnings

av_count.definition: Actual loaded AV roster, not requested percentage

av_completed.definition: Completed evaluation requests assigned to actual AV IDs

human_completed.definition: Completed evaluation requests assigned to human IDs

av_share_served.definition: AV completed / all completed evaluation requests; allocation, not welfare

av_utilization.definition: Occupied AV seconds / actual AV online seconds in evaluation clock

av_idle_share.definition: Unlogged or explicitly idle AV seconds / AV online seconds in evaluation clock

eligible_av_service_rate.definition: AV completed / fixed AV-eligible evaluation requests

eligible_wait_mean_s.definition: Served evaluation requests satisfying declared opt-in and both-endpoint fence

other_wait_mean_s.definition: Served evaluation requests outside declared AV eligibility

av_empty_distance_share.definition: Empty / all AV driven distance, whole physical run

idle_av_closer_human_won_rate.definition: Eligible human-won diagnostics with idle AV closer / eligible human-won diagnostics with defined ETA gap

common_human_completed.definition: Evaluation trips served by the same always-human prefix IDs within the input regime

common_human_trips_per_online_hour.definition: Same human-prefix evaluation trips / prefix evaluation-clock online hours

rule_violations.definition: Zero only after physical accounting, event, capacity and applicable eligibility/privacy checks pass
